Name: Crescent237's Cat Pack
Author: vampycritters
Description:
Includes 11 vanilla-friendly natural cat skins and 2 strange cat skins based on the vanilla sprites.
Natural: Dilute Torbie (var1), Gray, Cream, Cinnamon (narrow face), Orange tabby (narrow face, based on my cat irl), Black, White with black splotches, White with orange tabby splotches, Tortoiseshell, White, and Dilute Torbie (var2, boxy face)
Strange: Zombie (great for halloween) and Shadow (resembles Krobus a little)

Installed like a typical Adopt 'n' Skin skin pack.

Downloads.Description: 3 new cats, fixed an issue in the sprites, also apparently there were only 10 cats before because there was no cat_4 for some reason
